title: Informal spoken interpreting
description: Convey the meaning of a short spoken message between two languages while preserving the speaker’s intent and acknowledging uncertainty.
oneStarDescription: In a low-stakes practice exercise, relay a short sentence in the other language without adding opinions.
twoStarDescription: Interpret a short multi-sentence exchange and ask for repetition when a name, number or phrase is unclear.
threeStarDescription: Interpret a longer low-stakes exchange, clarify ambiguous wording and distinguish the speaker’s words from your own explanation.

title: Interleave similar types of practice
description: Alternate related problem types or concepts so you practise deciding which approach fits each case rather than repeating only one type at a time.
oneStarDescription: Practise a small set of two related task types in alternating order.
twoStarDescription: Mix several similar-looking tasks and select the method for each before checking the result.
threeStarDescription: Record why the wrong method was selected and adapt the next mixed set to address that confusion.

title: Solve jigsaw puzzles strategically
description: Organise pieces and use shape, colour, pattern and image structure to assemble a jigsaw without relying on random placement alone.
oneStarDescription: Separate edge pieces and organise a few obvious colour or pattern groups before assembling.
twoStarDescription: Complete distinct regions using shape and image clues, then connect the regions.
threeStarDescription: Compare shape, colour and neighbouring image details to resolve difficult placements and revise incorrect sections.

title: Learn concepts through concrete examples
description: Make abstract ideas easier to understand by generating, comparing and checking specific examples and counterexamples.
oneStarDescription: Give a specific example of a concept and explain which features make it fit.
twoStarDescription: Compare two cases and identify which features are essential and which are incidental.
threeStarDescription: Create or identify a nearby case that does not fit, and explain the distinguishing feature.

title: Nonverbal communication
description: Notice and use visible and vocal cues while remembering that gestures and expressions are context-dependent and do not reliably reveal a person’s thoughts by themselves.
oneStarDescription: Describe two observable cues in a short interaction without claiming to know the person’s hidden intent.
twoStarDescription: Practise using a suitable posture, eye contact where culturally comfortable, and tone for two different settings.
threeStarDescription: When a cue is ambiguous, ask a respectful clarifying question and revise your interpretation based on the response.

title: Choose routes in orienteering
description: Compare possible routes between mapped checkpoints, balancing distance, terrain, path features and the likelihood of navigating accurately.
oneStarDescription: Choose a route along clear paths between two controls and explain the main landmarks you expect to use.
twoStarDescription: Compare two feasible routes using distance, terrain and navigation difficulty, then justify your choice.
threeStarDescription: After a beginner course, compare planned and actual route choices and identify one decision to improve.

title: Play xiangqi
description: Play a game of xiangqi whose aim is the opponent's general, using a reference for the setup and the moves rather than a memorised rule book in this proposal.
oneStarDescription: Set the starting position from a diagram you can show, including the river and the palaces.
twoStarDescription: Play until the opponent's general is checkmated or a player has no legal move, and say which of those ended it.
threeStarDescription: After the game, point to one position where a piece was left open and say what you would do differently.

title: Proofread and track recurring writing errors
description: Review a finished draft for spelling, punctuation, grammar and obvious clarity problems using a consistent checking method.
oneStarDescription: Find and correct obvious spelling, punctuation and typographical errors in a short text.
twoStarDescription: Proofread a longer text using separate passes for different error types and record recurring mistakes.
threeStarDescription: Read a final draft aloud or in a different format, fix awkward or unclear passages and verify the corrections.

title: Public speaking and audience adaptation
description: Prepare and deliver a short talk with a clear structure, suitable examples and language adapted to the audience.
oneStarDescription: Give a one-minute explanation with a clear opening, main point and closing.
twoStarDescription: Deliver the same topic to two different audiences, changing the examples or terminology appropriately.
threeStarDescription: Give a three-to-five-minute talk and respond to a question while keeping the central message clear.

title: Record and interpret local weather
description: Measure the weather where you are, record it, and compare it with a forecast without treating the forecast as your own observation.
oneStarDescription: Take one weather measurement you can explain, such as temperature or rainfall, and record the place and time.
twoStarDescription: At one time, record more than one kind of sign, such as cloud and wind or temperature and rain, and say how they fit the conditions you see.
threeStarDescription: Compare your record with a published forecast and state one agreement and one difference, including fronts or isobars only if you can point to them on the map you used.

title: Practise recalling information from memory
description: Strengthen study routines by attempting to recall material before checking notes, then using errors to guide the next review.
oneStarDescription: After studying a short topic, answer a few questions from memory before reopening the material.
twoStarDescription: Compare answers with reliable notes and correct gaps or misconceptions.
threeStarDescription: Create and reuse questions across a topic, mixing factual recall with explanation and application.

title: Revise writing for coherence
description: Improve an existing draft by checking its central point, order, relevance and transitions before polishing sentence-level details.
oneStarDescription: Write a short margin label for each paragraph and identify places where the sequence is confusing or repetitive.
twoStarDescription: Move or combine paragraphs and improve transitions so that ideas follow a clear sequence.
threeStarDescription: Compare the revised draft with the original and explain how each major change improves logic, relevance or reader understanding.

title: Translate short texts faithfully
description: Translate short written messages between languages while preserving meaning, tone and important details instead of translating word for word without context.
oneStarDescription: Translate a short everyday message and compare names, numbers and the central meaning against the original.
twoStarDescription: Translate a longer passage, checking idioms and register instead of mapping each word mechanically.
threeStarDescription: Revise a translation against the original and flag unresolved ambiguity rather than inventing a meaning.

title: Sketch what you see in the sky
description: Draw an astronomical object while you are looking at it, and correct the drawing from a second look rather than from a photograph.
oneStarDescription: Draw one object you are looking at and mark which direction is which.
twoStarDescription: Add the place, the time, and whether you used your eyes, binoculars, or a telescope, plus one detail you noticed only by looking longer.
threeStarDescription: Look again and change one mark that was not actually visible. Leave the correction visible.

title: Space practice over time
description: Plan multiple learning sessions separated by intervals rather than concentrating all review into one sitting.
oneStarDescription: Schedule at least two reviews on different days instead of doing the entire review at once.
twoStarDescription: Return to material after an interval and attempt recall before checking notes.
threeStarDescription: Use recall results to decide which topics need earlier review and which can wait longer.

title: Solve everyday problems systematically
description: Define a problem, identify constraints, compare options, try a suitable solution and review the result.
oneStarDescription: State the problem, desired outcome and one or two constraints without jumping straight to a solution.
twoStarDescription: List at least two feasible approaches, compare their trade-offs and select one for a small test.
threeStarDescription: Check whether the trial met the goal, explain what caused the result and adjust the next action.

title: Solve Sudoku puzzles with logical elimination
description: Solve number-placement puzzles by tracking constraints and using explicit logical deductions rather than guessing.
oneStarDescription: Complete simple placements by checking which digits are missing from a row, column or box.
twoStarDescription: Record possible digits in empty cells and eliminate candidates using visible constraints.
threeStarDescription: Solve a harder section by identifying a logical relationship that removes candidates, and explain why it must hold.

title: Read topographic maps and relate them to terrain
description: Interpret map symbols, scale, contours and visible landmarks to understand how a mapped area corresponds to real terrain.
oneStarDescription: Use the legend to identify several mapped features and locate them on a familiar, low-risk route.
twoStarDescription: Estimate a distance from the map scale and explain what contour spacing suggests about the shape or steepness of terrain.
threeStarDescription: On a simple marked route, match at least three terrain features to the map and explain where uncertainty remains.

title: Transcribe historical letters carefully
description: Turn a historical handwritten letter into a faithful text record while preserving meaningful punctuation and marking uncertain words or characters.
oneStarDescription: Type a short legible passage and compare it line by line with the image.
twoStarDescription: Preserve original spelling where instructed and mark unclear characters rather than silently modernising them.
threeStarDescription: Recheck a longer transcription, follow the project’s conventions and record unresolved readings consistently.

title: Map an argument visually
description: Represent a claim, its supporting reasons and relevant objections in a visual structure that makes the logic easier to inspect.
oneStarDescription: Draw one claim and connect it to two reasons that support it.
twoStarDescription: Label supporting evidence and the reasoning that links it to the claim; distinguish objections from supporting reasons.
threeStarDescription: Map a claim and a counterclaim, identify unsupported links and revise the diagram after checking the text.

title: Classify wildlife camera images
description: Classify camera-trap or trail-camera images according to a project’s stated rules, and record uncertainty instead of forcing a guess.
oneStarDescription: Classify a small set of images using the project’s examples and allowed categories.
twoStarDescription: Use visible evidence to distinguish similar cases and mark unclear images as uncertain when allowed.
threeStarDescription: Review a varied batch, compare difficult cases with project guidance and explain the basis for uncertain labels.

title: Outline and structure a piece of writing
description: Organise ideas into a logical sequence before drafting, grouping related points and showing how the parts support the purpose.
oneStarDescription: Create a title, purpose and ordered list of main points before writing a short piece.
twoStarDescription: Group related points, remove or relocate tangents and add supporting subpoints.
threeStarDescription: Create a hierarchical outline for a multi-section piece and explain how each section supports the main claim or story.

title: Back up and restore personal files
description: Make a second copy of personal files and prove you can restore one of them.
oneStarDescription: Copy one folder of personal files to a second place and check that the copy opens.
twoStarDescription: Delete or rename a practice copy and restore that file from the backup.
threeStarDescription: Change one file, make a new copy, and show which version you would use if the working copy were lost.

title: Capture speech in your own notes
description: Turn a short stretch of speech into notes you can read back. The source does not name a shorthand system, so none is required.
oneStarDescription: Write a short spoken message in abbreviations you choose and read it back without looking at a script.
twoStarDescription: Take notes while someone explains a familiar process and read back the points, marking anything you missed.
threeStarDescription: Compare the notes with the original speech, if you are allowed to hear it again, and change one abbreviation that caused a miss.

title: Check a surface before painting
description: Check scratches, dirt, moisture and old covering, and say whether the surface is ready.
oneStarDescription: On one surface, note scratches, dents, grease, dirt, moisture and traces of an old covering.
twoStarDescription: Remove loose dust or dirt by a method that does not require a chemical you have not identified, and look again.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the surface looks ready, or what sign still blocks painting, without choosing a coating product.

title: Compare equipment before buying
description: Compare equipment or parts on what they must do, price and delivery time.
oneStarDescription: Write what the equipment or part must do and which limits matter, such as size or a deadline.
twoStarDescription: Record the price and delivery time of each offer you are actually considering, with the source of the figures.
threeStarDescription: Say which offer you would choose and one fact the sources still do not tell you.

title: Edit a shared document
description: Change a document that someone else can also edit, without erasing their point, and leave a trace of what you changed.
oneStarDescription: In a shared practice document, add or edit a passage the other person can see.
twoStarDescription: Make a change that responds to their text and leave their point still visible.
threeStarDescription: Leave the document so a third person can tell what you changed and what was already there.

title: Explain a small crowdfunding project
description: State a project, what the money is for, and what is still uncertain. Do not copy a platform's campaign template.
oneStarDescription: Write what the project is, what the money is for and what a backer would receive, in your own words.
twoStarDescription: Read the rules of one real platform and mark which of your statements those rules allow.
threeStarDescription: Revise the explanation so a reader can see what is already decided and what is still unknown, including the budget gap.

title: Make a simple technical drawing
description: Make a labeled drawing of a simple object that another person can recognise.
oneStarDescription: Use drawing software to make one view of a simple object and label its main parts.
twoStarDescription: Measure the object and put those measurements on the drawing, including the unit.
threeStarDescription: Give the drawing to someone else and ask them to name the object and one dimension. Note any miss.

title: Make and check a reservation
description: Book a restaurant, hotel or journey and check that the confirmation matches the request.
oneStarDescription: Write the date, place, number of people and any limit you must not miss for a restaurant, hotel or journey.
twoStarDescription: Complete one booking and check that the confirmation matches the date, place and party size.
threeStarDescription: Using the provider's own rules, change or cancel the practice booking, or write the deadline if a change is no longer allowed.

title: Notice signs of wood rot
description: Look and listen for signs of rot and write down what you found for someone qualified.
oneStarDescription: On one wooden element, look for visible signs of rot and note what sound it makes when you tap it.
twoStarDescription: Compare the suspect piece with a sound piece nearby and write which differences you can actually see or hear.
threeStarDescription: Record the place, the date and the signs, and state that you are not choosing a treatment.

title: Plan a small event
description: Turn a gathering into an agenda, a simple budget and a check against one real constraint.
oneStarDescription: For a small gathering, write the purpose, the order of the occasion and a simple list of costs.
twoStarDescription: Check the plan against the number of people and one real limit, such as the room or the time, and change the plan if it does not fit.
threeStarDescription: After the gathering, or after a realistic rehearsal of the plan, note one thing to change next time and why.

title: Read a household gas meter
description: Record what a household gas meter shows. This is not a repair or a leak check.
oneStarDescription: Read the figures on a household gas meter and write the number with the date.
twoStarDescription: Compare a new reading with an earlier one and say whether use went up, down or stayed too close to call.
threeStarDescription: Show someone else the reading, the date and what the meter is measuring, and mark anything you could not read.

title: Read a technical drawing
description: Read a technical drawing well enough to name the parts, use a stated measurement, and say what the drawing does not tell you.
oneStarDescription: From one technical drawing, name the main parts it shows.
twoStarDescription: Read one dimension, including its unit, and say which part it belongs to.
threeStarDescription: Say one thing a person would still need to know before making or ordering the object.

title: Write in a language you are learning
description: Write a short text of your own in a language you are learning, and mark what you are not sure of. This is not translation and not a separate skill for each language.
oneStarDescription: Write a few sentences on a familiar topic and check that they say what you meant.
twoStarDescription: Rewrite the same point so a reader who shares the language can follow it, using a reference you trust for words you could not recall.
threeStarDescription: Write a short note for a real reader and mark the words or sentences you are not sure of.

title: Basic baking techniques
description: Learn how ingredient handling and mixing methods affect baked results, including kneading dough, rubbing fat into flour, and making batter. This is a technique skill, not a separate skill for every baked dish.
oneStarDescription: Measure ingredients and make one simple batter or rubbed-in mixture with the texture described by a trustworthy recipe.
twoStarDescription: Make a simple dough and demonstrate controlled kneading until it reaches the recipe’s stated texture, or explain why the chosen mixture should not be kneaded.
threeStarDescription: Complete a simple baked item and identify one evidence-based adjustment after evaluating its texture or structure.

title: Compare financial offers
description: Find reliable information and compare financial products or offers using the terms that matter, rather than choosing from headline prices alone.
oneStarDescription: Find two comparable offers and record where the information came from, including the key terms and fees available.
twoStarDescription: Compare two offers using the same assumptions and a written table of price, fees, conditions, and relevant restrictions.
threeStarDescription: Compare at least three options or scenarios and explain the trade-offs and uncertainties behind a choice.

title: Cook rice reliably
description: Control water, heat, timing, and resting so rice cooks evenly and reaches the intended texture. The progression focuses on method and consistency rather than collecting rice recipes.
oneStarDescription: Cook one batch of rice using a reliable method and produce grains that are cooked through without a pool of excess water.
twoStarDescription: Repeat the method successfully twice and identify how rinsing, liquid ratio, heat, or resting affected the texture.
threeStarDescription: Prepare rice for two different meal contexts and explain the process change needed for the target texture or serving time.

title: Egg preparation techniques
description: Handle eggs cleanly and perform common preparation techniques, including separating an egg and poaching it. The skill is evaluated by process control, not by collecting egg recipes.
oneStarDescription: Separate an egg into yolk and white with minimal mixing and without shell fragments in the portions.
twoStarDescription: Poach an egg so the white is set and the result matches the selected method’s target texture.
threeStarDescription: Choose and perform two egg techniques for different cooking goals, explaining the cues used to judge the result.

title: Kitchen food safety
description: Organise food preparation to reduce avoidable risks from contamination, unsafe handling, knives, heat, and storage.
oneStarDescription: Prepare a clean workspace, identify likely hazards in a simple cooking task, and choose safe handling steps before beginning.
twoStarDescription: Complete a simple preparation task using separate clean tools/surfaces as appropriate and demonstrate correct handwashing at relevant points.
threeStarDescription: Finish one simple meal. Point to where raw food stayed off food that is ready to eat, where the hot pan stayed, and where leftovers went. If you do not know a storage time or temperature, say so instead of guessing one.
